meta.name: OrbitNsukka Health Monitor - indicator thresholds
meta.status: v0.4 - v0.3 (signed and frozen under D-42) plus the impossible-reading limits (D-48) and the blood-pressure latest-reading rule (D-49). Version bumped per D-42; Integration reruns its checks.
meta.single_source_of_truth: D-38: the engine and generate_synthetic_data.py both read this file. If a sheet and this file disagree, this file wins and the sheet is fixed.
meta.units_policy: Canonical units: bpm, mmHg, mg/dL, Celsius, hours, 1-5 tap, PHQ-2 0-6. Display layers may convert.

status_meaning.normal: Green: inside the published range. Keep logging.
status_meaning.warning: Amber: log it and tell the crew medical officer (S-31).
status_meaning.contact: Red: request a private medical conference with the flight surgeon now (S-32).

meta.how_bands_work: Each band has an inclusive min and max. Readings are rounded to the band resolution before they are classified, so every possible value lands in exactly one band. A band with no min starts at minus infinity; no max runs to plus infinity.
meta.how_status_is_combined: Final status = the worst of (single-reading band, symptom rules, pattern rules). The only rule that can lower a status is heart_rate.baseline_rule.
meta.honesty_note: Bands are Earth adult values from public clinical sources (IDs are Sources.md IDs). NASA crew in-flight thresholds (NASA-STD-3001, flight rules) are not fully public. Red levels are adaptations for an educational demo and need review by medical operations before any real use. Values marked team_choice are illustrative.
meta.sources_on_every_band: Every band and rule carries a 'sources' list (handoff contract, index section 3). Team choices say so in place of an S-ID.
meta.ai_generation: AI-generated: drafted by an AI assistant (Claude, Anthropic) at the team leader's direction, then reviewed and signed by the team leader. Disclosed under D-44. Contains no NASA branding, logos, flags or mission identifiers.
meta.input_safety: D-48: each indicator has a plausible_range. A value outside it is not judged: the app asks again. If the same value is entered twice in a row it is accepted and judged, so a real emergency is never blocked.
meta.symptom_entry: Symptoms are entered manually by the astronaut with each reading (D-51); the symptom lists in each indicator are the checklist.

indicators.label: Heart rate (resting)
indicators.measurement: At rest after about 5 minutes still; device or 60-second count; log which.

baseline_rule.rule: If the median of the astronaut's previous 14 readings (at least 7 needed) is below 60, and today's reading is within 10 bpm of that median, the reading shows normal with the note 'inside your usual range'.
baseline_rule.note: Illustrative numbers. In a real mission the flight surgeon sets each astronaut's personal range (research brief, section 2).
sources: team choice, signed by the team leader (D-39)

symptoms: pounding or irregular heartbeat that does not settle
symptom_rules.note: Red when an abnormal rate (below 60 or above 100) comes with any of these symptoms (research brief, S-22, D-33). No number alone is red.

indicators.symptom_entry: Symptoms are entered manually by the astronaut with each reading (D-51).

indicators.label: Blood pressure
indicators.measurement: Upper-arm cuff, seated, 5 minutes rest, arm at heart level; two readings 1 minute apart, log both.
indicators.combine: Classify systolic and diastolic separately; the reading takes the worse of the two.

low_reading.rule: systolic 90 or lower, or diastolic 60 or lower
low_reading.without_symptoms: no change of colour; note 'low reading, recheck after fluids and rest' (S-130: low pressure is a problem only with symptoms)

symptoms: systolic drop of 20 mmHg or more on standing, with dizziness
symptom_rules.note: Standing check after Earth return or in partial gravity. No held source yet (D-34).
sources: team choice, signed by the team leader (D-39)

indicators.readings: Two readings one minute apart are stored; the latest one is judged (D-49).

indicators.label: Blood sugar (before meal)
indicators.measurement: Before meals only (D-23, D-27). Enter the reading from whatever meter the crew has and record which meter (D-29). The tool makes no claim about meter accuracy. A reading taken on waking is accepted, so long as it is before a meal (D-40).

bands.label: Below 54
bands.note: Level 2 low (S-132): treat and contact now

bands.label: 54 to 69
bands.note: Level 1 low (S-132): take 15 g fast sugar, recheck in 15 minutes, report

bands.label: 126 to 250
bands.note: High; report. A single reading is amber, never red.

bands.label: Above 250
sources: research brief red line; confirm at CP-S2

symptom_rules.note: Confusion at any reading is red (research brief).
Treat as low sugar first, even if the number looks borderline.

indicators.label: Body temperature (oral reference)
indicators.measurement: One method for the whole mission, recorded with every reading (D-35). The bands are oral. A reading taken another way is marked and not compared with these bands (skin devices read about 0.6 C lower, S-27).

bands.label: Below 35.0
sources: team choice, signed by the team leader (D-39)

bands.label: 35.0 to 35.9
bands.note: No held source; warm layers and recheck
sources: team choice, signed by the team leader (D-39)

indicators.context_note: S-46: core temperature runs about 1 C higher in flight. A personal in-flight baseline is not adopted yet.

indicators.label: Sleep hours (per night)
indicators.measurement: Daily sleep log (lights out, lights on); wrist actigraphy when available.

indicators.label: Mood (daily 1-5 tap + weekly PHQ-2)
indicators.measurement: D-31: the daily tap (5 = very good, 1 = very low) is a trend only; the weekly PHQ-2 gives the sourced amber. Private by default.

bands.label: Any tap
bands.note: A single tap never sets a colour (D-31); the pattern rules below do.

questions: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
weekly_phq2.item_scoring: 0-3 each: not at all = 0, several days = 1, more than half the days = 2, nearly every day = 3

bands.note: Raise at the next medical conference (S-135, research brief)

weekly_phq2.licence_note: Free to reproduce (S-30). A screen, not a diagnosis.

symptoms: severe distress or unable to continue (marked by the astronaut)

pattern_rules.label: 6 hours or less on 3 nights in a row
Tap of 2 or lower on 2 days in a row
Tap of 2 or lower on 5 of the last 7 days
126 or higher on 2 days within a week: report it
sources: team choice, signed by the team leader (D-39)

pattern_rules.label: 140/90 or more on 2 days within a week: report it

pattern_rules.action: anomaly flag: needs a medical check
pattern_rules.label: 140/90 or more still present a week after an earlier one
sources: team choice, signed by the team leader (D-39)
